model_annotations.Bulgarian: The bar chart displays the accuracy (%) of five different methods—DAPO+Self-reflection, GRPO, DAPO, SRPO, and PPO—across three distinct domains: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The vertical axis represents accuracy in percentage, ranging from 50% to 62%, with labeled tick marks at intervals of 2%. The horizontal axis lists the three domains. For each domain, a group of five bars, each with a distinct pattern and color, represents the performance of one method. In Mathverse, DAPO+Self-reflection achieves the highest accuracy at approximately 56.1%, followed by SRPO at 55.8%, GRPO at 53.5%, PPO at 53.3%, and DAPO at 53.1%. In MMLU, DAPO+Self-reflection again shows the highest accuracy at around 56.9%, followed by SRPO at 57.1%, GRPO at 55.7%, PPO at 54.6%, and DAPO at 55.9%. In Physics, DAPO+Self-reflection has the highest accuracy at approximately 61.0%, followed by SRPO at 60.5%, GRPO at 58.2%, PPO at 57.0%, and DAPO at 57.5%. The legend in the top right corner identifies each method by its corresponding color and pattern.

model_annotations.English: The bar chart displays the accuracy (%) of five different methods—DAPO+Self-reflection, GRPO, DAPO, PPO+Self-reflection, and SRPO—across three domains: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The vertical axis represents accuracy in percentage, ranging from 50% to 62%, with major tick marks at 50, 52, 54, 56, 58, 60, and 62. The horizontal axis lists the three domains. Each domain has a group of five bars, with distinct patterns and colors corresponding to the methods as defined in the legend. In the Mathverse domain, DAPO has the lowest accuracy (approximately 53.1%), while DAPO+Self-reflection achieves the highest (approximately 56.1%). In MMLU, DAPO+Self-reflection again shows the highest accuracy (approximately 57.0%), and SRPO has the lowest (approximately 55.8%). In the Physics domain, DAPO+Self-reflection reaches the highest accuracy (approximately 61.0%), and PPO+Self-reflection has the lowest (approximately 56.2%). The chart indicates that DAPO+Self-reflection consistently performs the best across all three domains, while DAPO generally performs the worst.
model_annotations.German: The bar chart displays the accuracy (%) of five different models—DAPO+Self-reflection, GRPO, DAPO, PPO+Self-reflection, and SRPO—across three distinct domains: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The vertical axis represents accuracy in percentage, ranging from 50% to 62%, with labeled tick marks at intervals of 2%. The horizontal axis lists the three domains. For each domain, five bars are grouped together, each corresponding to one of the models and distinguished by a unique color and pattern as indicated in the legend. In the Mathverse domain, DAPO+Self-reflection (blue) and SRPO (orange) achieve the highest accuracy, both around 56%, while DAPO (light blue with diagonal lines) and GRPO (orange with diagonal lines) are lower, at approximately 53% and 53.5% respectively, and PPO+Self-reflection (dark green) is the lowest at about 54.5%. In the MMLU domain, DAPO+Self-reflection (blue) again leads with an accuracy of about 57%, followed by SRPO (orange) at approximately 57.2%, GRPO (orange with diagonal lines) at around 55.8%, DAPO (light blue with diagonal lines) at about 55.8%, and PPO+Self-reflection (dark green) at roughly 56.2%. In the Physics domain, DAPO+Self-reflection (blue) shows the highest accuracy at approximately 61.5%, followed closely by SRPO (orange) at about 60.8%, GRPO (orange with diagonal lines) at around 58.2%, DAPO (light blue with diagonal lines) at approximately 57.5%, and PPO+Self-reflection (dark green) at about 59.2%. The bars within each group are arranged side-by-side, and the chart visually highlights that DAPO+Self-reflection consistently performs well, particularly in Physics, while PPO+Self-reflection shows the most variable performance across domains.
